gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Filter value extraction and placeholder substitution
gotchas_discovered.description: The '{value}' placeholder in filter_kwargs needs to be substituted with the actual request parameter value during filter application
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documentation includes clear examples showing the placeholder usage pattern

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Empty filter values are silently ignored
gotchas_discovered.description: Filter values that are empty strings or None are not applied to the queryset, which may be unexpected behavior
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documented in Notes section as expected behavior

gotchas_discovered.description: The returned 'queryset' is actually a Page object, not a full queryset, which may confuse developers
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicitly documented in Returns section and template examples show proper usage

gotchas_discovered.description: Custom filter functions must accept (queryset, value) parameters and return a queryset, but this might not be obvious
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Documented with clear signature and multiple working examples
